notes.title: QUESTER + Dragon Ruins Bundle Available!
notes.content:
Hello, fellow adventurers!

We are happy to announce that we've entered a cross-promotional collaboration with Graverobber Foundation.

Now you can complete the QUESTER + Dragon Ruins set with an additional discount by purchasing the bundle on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/45251/QUESTER__DRAGON_RUINS/

What is Dragon Ruins?
Dragon Ruins is a tiny dungeon crawler designed for tired people. Assemble a party of four heroes, delve into the dungeon, decide when to fight or run away, and grow stronger to survive the run to the dragon's lair in this micro dungeon crawler.

What is QUESTER?
It is a decadent future world built by manga artist Kazushi Hagiwara. A dungeon exploration RPG specializing in hack-and-slash. The game is full of challenging elements. There are 24 characters (8 classes), skills to enjoy combos, modifiable armaments, "NEW GAME+" to enjoy playing around, etc.

Message from Graverobber Foundation
As long-time fans of dungeon crawlers, we wish to support each other and ensure that we can continue creating quality works for our fans and serve different niches within an expansive genre. We hope our fans will see this collaboration as a seal of approval for each other's projects and come together to enjoy our past, present, and future games.

We would like to thank Thousand Games for this opportunity to collaborate.

Have fun!

notes.title: A major update was made on April 26!
notes.content:
Thoughts on "QUESTER"

"It doesn't matter if it's a small project. I want to work with you because it sounds fun.
A game specializing in hack and slash should have potential even today." 
This is what Kazushi Hagiwara told me.

"I had been thinking that I really wanted to make a dungeon-crawler RPG. I was looking for an opportunity to do so when I was approached, so the timing was perfect. 
I honestly wondered if God was watching me or might be reading my mind." 
Hironori Kato told me this enthusiastically.

Despite the goals I set, things aren't working out. In that case, let's do what we want to do.
Let's make a game that we all want to play, that has the excitement and surprise that I felt playing the PC games of the 80s.
I put the company's future on the line with this project.
It may be small, but for me, it is a project that I have put my life on the line for.

With your support, the circle of this project has expanded little by little, and we have reached the first anniversary of the official release. Thank you very much.

To express our gratitude for the first anniversary, we are pleased to present our first major update.
We look forward to your continued support for many years to come.

Thousand Games Co., Ltd.
Representative: Toshimichi Kuwahara


Update of “QUESTER”

 You can now select your starting party.
 New weapons and events have been added.
 User Interface has been improved with new features, including the Arms Encyclopedia and Item lock function.
 NEW GAME+ specifications have been changed.
 Game balance has been adjusted.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1754460/QUESTER/

notes.title: Special interviews will be released.
notes.content:
Interview with the creator of QUESTER

Special interviews with Kazushi Hagiwara, Hironori Kato, and Toshimichi Kuwahara will be released to commemorate the Tokyo Game Show exhibition of the hack-and-slash RPG "QUESTER". 

The interview covers the worldbuilding and game design of "QUESTER," Kazushi Hagiwara's debut as a manga artist, the early gaming experiences of the main creators, and many other fun stories. Please go and check it out!


Kazushi Hagiwara (original concept and character design)
Representative works: "Bastard!! The Dark God of Destruction" etc.

Hironori Kato (Game Designer)

Representative works: "ELDEN RING TRPG", "Monster Collection TCG", etc.

Toshimichi Kuwahara (Producer)

Representative Works: "Sky Galleon of the Azure", "Flyhight Cloudia", etc.

※The interviewer is Toshimichi Kuwahara.

#01
[olist]
 What kind of RPGs have you been playing?
 Memories of "Wizardry"
 The project inspired by classic "hack and slash".

notes.title: QUESTER Official Anthology Call for Manuscripts!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44042748/611e6f05a9ac6dd6eb3edd2f26fb97fe60ef9793.jpg
QUESTER will participate in an in-person exhibit at the Tokyo Game Show 2023 Indie Game Corner!
The hack-and-slash RPG "QUESTER" has been invited to join the "Selected Indie 80" exhibit at Tokyo Game Show 2023 and will be featured in-person at the Indie Game Corner.

QUESTER Official Anthology Manuscripts Wanted!
At Tokyo Game Show 2023, we are planning to distribute the "QUESTER Official Anthology" booklet for free.
We will have a "QUESTER Friendship Club" section in which we will publish your submissions.
We invite you to send us your illustrations, four-frame manga, short stories, etc.!
Fan letters and written impressions are also welcome.
We are looking forward to receiving your submissions!

Application rules, etc.
Application URL: https://form.run/@tk-1666013680
Deadline: August 20, 2023
We would like to publish as many entries as possible, but depending on the volume of submissions received or other factors we may be unable to publish everything we receive.
We may use your work in future promotional materials and concept guidebooks other than the "QUESTER Official Anthology".
